data.job: Turn these app reviews into a ranked bug backlog

params.condition: Is this text written by a user about the app?
params.true_means: Any user feedback about the app: complaints, bug reports, praise, feature requests, questions, and comments about the articles, writers or other content in the app
params.false_means: Spam, advertisements, promotions, or text unrelated to the app

nodes.why: Drop spam and ads so later steps only judge real feedback.

params.instructions: Which category best describes the text?

options.bug: Reports something broken, crashing, failing, slow, or not working as expected
options.feature_request: Asks for new functionality or an option the app does not have yet
options.praise: Positive feedback with no complaint and no request
options.billing: About charges, payments, refunds, or subscriptions

nodes.why: Sort the feedback into bugs, feature requests, praise and billing.

params.focus: the specific problem or request in the feedback

nodes.why: Find the themes among bugs and feature requests.
Merge bug reports that describe the same problem.

dimensions.name: severity
dimensions.instructions: How severe is the problem described in the text for the user?
levels: A feature is broken or unusable
The app crashes, loses data, or charges money wrongly

nodes.why: Rate how severe each bug is for the user.

params.criterion: urgency of fixing this issue for users

nodes.why: Order the bugs by urgency, one entry per duplicate group, to make the backlog.
Count items per type and theme and average the bug urgency for the report.

data.why: Drop spam and ads so later steps only judge real feedback.
Sort the feedback into bugs, feature requests, praise and billing.
Find the themes among bugs and feature requests.

value.name: Login Failure
value.description: Users cannot sign in or log in to the app, often after an update or with various methods; not about sign-up issues.

value.name: Sign-up Failure
value.description: Users cannot create a new account or sign up for the app; not about logging into an existing account.

value.name: Social Login Issues
value.description: Problems logging in specifically through social media accounts like Twitter, Google, or Google+; not about email or other login methods.

value.name: Email Link Error
value.description: Issues with the email verification link sent for login or sign-up, such as errors or not receiving the link; not about other login methods.

value.name: App Performance Lag
value.description: The app is slow, laggy, or has poor scrolling performance; not about crashes or freezes.

value.name: App Crashes
value.description: The app crashes or freezes frequently; not about general slowness or lag.

value.name: Data Usage High
value.description: The app consumes excessive mobile data; not about app size or storage.

value.name: App Size Large
value.description: The app takes up a large amount of storage space; not about data usage.

value.name: Offline Mode Missing
value.description: Users want an offline mode to read saved articles without internet; not about other features.

value.name: Reading History Missing
value.description: There is no easy way to view reading history or previously liked stories; not about other missing features.

value.name: Article Limit
value.description: Users are limited in the number of free articles they can read per month; not about subscription costs.

value.name: Recommendation Algorithm Poor
value.description: The recommendation algorithm suggests irrelevant or repetitive articles; not about search functionality.

value.name: Writing and Editing Broken
value.description: Users cannot write, edit, or delete posts in the app; not issues with reading articles.

value.name: Dark Mode Unreadable
value.description: Text or titles are unreadable or poorly displayed in dark mode; not missing dark mode.

value.name: Missing App Features
value.description: Features available on the website are missing in the app, such as publications, drafts, or series; not general app crashes.

notes: refinement: ran on 152 outliers; 3 new themes (Writing and Editing Broken, Dark Mode Unreadable, Missing App Features)
